title: DWI Stop & Arrest
summary: From the first driving cue to the summonses.

steps.text: Note driving cues: weaving, drifting, speed changes, braking problems, judgment errors
Note how the vehicle stops
Observe and note odor, eyes, speech, dexterity with documents, answers to questions
Ask about drinking, drugs, medical conditions, and when last eaten and slept
Body-worn camera on and positioned to record the tests
Check the surface, lighting, footwear and weather
Horizontal Gaze Nystagmus
Walk and Turn
One Leg Stand
Arrest when probable cause exists; search incident to arrest
Arrange for the vehicle: impound for 12 hours per 39:4-50.23
Check for passengers 17 or younger (39:4-50.15)
Start and record the 20-minute observation period
Read the AG standard statement exactly as written
Breath test by a certified operator; keep the printouts
Refusal or conditional answer: document it and charge 39:4-50.4a
If impairment doesn't match the breath result, request a DRE
Blood draw needs a warrant unless an exigency exists (Missouri v. McNeely)
Issue summonses: 39:4-50 and related violations
Complete the drinking-driver / alcohol influence report
Release only to a responsible adult per policy

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
